title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-06-07
source: Composite from 3 different source reels; Editing(Adobe Audition CC)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name)-Processing (izotope oZone 6) by Jim Wise

ai_review.summary: Excellent summer‑69 soundboard capture featuring a rare long jam and strong Janis‑Pigpen moments, despite some rough edges.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers clear, well‑balanced sound that lets the unusual extended jam shine, and listeners enjoy the interplay between Janis Joplin and Pig Pen on tracks like "Lovelight". While a few reviewers note the show was a bit rough overall, the performance is praised for its energy and the abundance of Jerry Garcia‑led material.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviews are highly positive about both the music and sound quality, with only one strongly negative comment; weighted average of show (≈4.5) and recording (≈4.0) yields a ~4.3 rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall with no major drop‑outs; reviewers describe the sound as "really good" despite the show being a bit rough.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Includes an unusually long jam and lively Janis‑Pigpen interplay, giving the set a loose but engaging flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Most of the material is Jerry‑led; no specific guitar remarks beyond that.
